patch.value: Make source-quality and exact 100/100/100 coverage gates fail closed repo-wide

The current coverage gate measures src only at 81/77/88 and the repository lacks mandatory fail-closed lint, docstring-coverage, and duplication gates. This independently blocks production/publication readiness beyond the compatibility tranche.

Every executable authored TypeScript file is enumerated or discovered fail-closed; Coverage is exactly 100/100/100 with behavior-driven tests; Docstring, lint, duplication, and anti-cheat checks are mandatory in release:check and CI

All authored runtime source and scripts are governed by exact 100 percent lines, branches, and functions plus strict docstring, lint, and duplication checks that cannot be bypassed by source omission.
coverageGate.sources contains only src with thresholds 81/77/88; no mandatory docstring, lint, or duplication gates are present.
Regressions or undocumented behavior could pass release checks, so the package cannot honestly be called production or publication ready.

value.text: Failure probes exposed two Node runner edge cases: an empty skipped suite has skipped=0 in the aggregate counters; a file with no declared tests counts as one passing file test.
